name: Pre-Engagement - Legal Precautions
description: Pre-Engagement - Legal Precautions - reference (methodology, not a runnable command).
notes: Precautions during a test: obtain WRITTEN consent from the owner/authorized rep; test ONLY within the consented scope and respect limitations; take measures to avoid damage; do not access/use/disclose personal data without permission; do not intercept communications without consent of a party; do not test HIPAA-covered systems without proper authorization. Laws differ by region (USA/EU/UK/India/China) - the RoE and contract are your legal cover.
